extracted.name: Cinnamon Sugar Tortilla Delight
extracted.description: This cinnamon sugar tortilla flavored with butter is rolled up and warmed in the microwave for a quick and easy low-fat treat, ready in 30 seconds.
instruction_lines: Spread tortilla with butter-flavored spread; sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Roll into a tube shape, then place on a microwave-safe plate.
Microwave on high until warm, about 30 seconds.
